items.text: Benza izindwangu ezibubende, eziyibubende, nezibomvu, zokukhonza endlini engcwele, benza izambatho ezingcwele zika-Aroni; njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
Wenza ingubo yamahlombe ngegolide, nokububende, nokububende, nokubomvu, nelineni elicolekileyo lemicu ephothiweyo.
Base beshaya izingcwecwe ezicashile zegolide, bazisika zaba izintambo, ukuze bazenze ngokububende, nangokububende, nangokubomvu, nangelineni elicolekileyo, umsebenzi wobuciko.
Bayenzela iziziba zamahlombe ukuze ilihlanganise, yahlanganiswa emaceleni omabili.
Ibhande le-efodi eliphezu kwayo lalivela kuyo njengomsebenzi wayo; ngegolide, nokububende, nokububende, nokubomvu, nelineni elicolekileyo lemicu ephothiweyo; njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
Bakha amatshe e-shohamu ashunyekwe ezingxenyeni zegolide, aqoshwa njengokuqoshwa kwezimpawu ngamagama abantwana bakwa-Israyeli.
Wawabeka ezizibeni zamahlombe e-efodi, abe ngamatshe esikhumbuzo sabantwana bakwa-Israyeli; njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
Wenza isihlangu sesifuba, ngomsebenzi wengcitshi, njengomsebenzi we-efodi; ngegolide, nokububende, nokububende, nokubomvu, nelineni elicolekileyo lemicu ephothiweyo.
Laliyizinhlangothi ezine ezilinganayo; bawuphinda kabili umphongolo, ubude bawo babungukwelulwa kweminwe, ububanzi bawo buphindwe kabili.
Bafaka kulo izinhla ezine zamatshe; bekuwumugqa wokuqala.
Uhla lwesibili lwaba yisimaragidu, nesafire, nedayimani;
uhla lwesithathu lwaba yihakiki, ne-agathe, ne-amethiste;
uhla lwesine lwaba yiriyeli, neshohamu, nejaspi; ayevalelwe emasaka egolide emacaleni awo.
Amatshe ayelitshumi lambili njengamabizo abantwana bakoIsrayeli, njengamabizo abo;
Benza esihlangwini sesifuba amaketanga emaceleni omsebenzi osontiwe ngegolide elicwengekileyo.
Benza amabhokisi amabili egolide namasongo amabili egolide; wafaka amasongo omabili emaceleni omabili esifuba.
Bawafaka amaketanga omabili egolide emasongweni omabili emaceleni esihlangu sesifuba.
Basebebophela izihloko zombili zamaketane ezitsheni zombili, bazifaka ezizibeni zamahlombe zengubo yamahlombe.
Benza amasongo amabili egolide, bawafaka emaceleni omabili esihlangu sesifuba emphethweni waso ongaphakathi kwe-efodi.
Benza amanye amasongo amabili egolide, bawafaka ezinhlangothini zombili zengubo yamahlombe phansi, malungana nesixhumanisi sayo, phezu kwebhande le-efodi.

Basibophela isihlangu sesifuba emasongweni aso emasongweni e-efodi ngentambo ebubende, ukuze sibe phezu kwebhande lasehlombe le-efodi, ukuze isihlangu sesifuba singahlukani nengubo yamahlombe; njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
Wenza ibhantshi le-efodi ngomsebenzi owelukiweyo, lonke ngokububende.
Kwakukhona imbobo phakathi kwejazi, njengembobo yejwabu, linebhande elizungeza imbobo, ukuze lingadabuki.
Benza izigqoko emphethweni wejazi ngokuyibubende, lokuyibubende, lokubomvu, lelineni elicolekileyo lemicu emibili.
Benza izikhencezo zegolide elicwengekileyo, babeka izikhencezo phakathi kwemigexo emiphethweni yejazi, inhlangothi zonke phakathi kwezigqoko;
isikhencezo negarnethi, isikhencezo negarnethi, emphethweni wejazi, ukukhonza; njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
Benza izigqoko zelineni elicolekileyo, umsebenzi owelukiweyo zika-Aroni namadodana akhe;
nesigqoko selineni elicolekileyo nezigqoko zelineni elicolekileyo nezibhulukhwe zelineni elicolekileyo elisontiwe;
nebhande lelineni elicolekileyo lemicu ephothiweyo, nokuyibubende, nokububende, nokubomvu, umsebenzi oyimithungo; njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
Benza ungcwecwe womqhele ongcwele ngegolide elicwengekileyo, baloba kuwo umbhalo njengokuqoshwa kophawu: Ungcwele kuJehova.
Basebebophela kuyo intambo ebubende ukuze ibotshwe phezu kweqhiye; njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
Waqedwa-ke wonke umsebenzi wetende lokuhlangana; abantwana bakwa-Israyeli benza njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose, benze njalo-ke.
Baliletha itabernakele kuMose, itende, nayo yonke impahla yalo, nezisekelo zalo, nezinsika zalo, nemishayo yalo, nezinsika zalo, nezinyawo zalo,
nesembozo sezikhumba zamanqama ezidaywe zaba bomvu, nesembozo sezikhumba zamatahasi, nesihenqo sengubo;
umphongolo wobufakazi nezinti zawo nesihlalo somusa;
itafula nezitsha zalo zonke nezinkwa zokubukwa,
uthi lwezibani oluhlanzekile nezibani zalo, nezibani zokulungiswa, nezinto zalo zonke, namafutha okukhanyisa,
ne-altare legolide, namafutha okugcoba, nempepho yamakha, nezilenge zomnyango wetabernakele;
i-altare lethusi, nehele lalo lethusi, nezinti zalo, nazo zonke izinto zalo, nomcengezi, nothi lwawo,
Izilenge zegceke, nezinsika zalo, nezinyawo zalo, nezilenge zesango legceke, nezintambo zalo, nezikhonkwane zalo, nezinto zonke zenkonzo yetabernakele letende lokuhlangana,
Izingubo zomsebenzi wenkonzo endlini engcwele nezingubo ezingcwele zika-Aroni umpristi nezingubo zamadodana akhe zokukhonza ubupristi.
Njengakho konke uJehova amyale ngakho uMose, abantwana bakwa-Israyeli bawenza wonke umsebenzi.
UMose wawubheka wonke umsebenzi, bheka, bawenza njengokuyala kukaJehova, bawenza; uMose wababusisa.
